summary.name: macSVG
summary.one_liner: macSVG is an MIT-licensed, open-source macOS app for designing and editing SVG graphics and SVG animations for HTML5 pages and other uses.
use_cases: Designing vector graphics for HTML5 web pages
Producing SVG art for mobile apps
Replacing GIF or Flash animations with SVG
summary.what_it_does: macSVG is a macOS application for designing and editing Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) content. It is aimed at HTML5 web pages, mobile apps, animation design, and general graphics work. The page says it can produce dynamic graphics and animation that display on major desktop and mobile platforms, including iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux. SVG documents can also embed JPEG and PNG images, combining vector and raster content. The page links to galleries of example animation files and screenshots.
notable: Native support for Apple Silicon M1/M2 Macs as of v1.2 (July 2022)
Generates SVG animations viewable in HTML5 web views
Galleries of example animation files and screenshots
caveats: Runs only on macOS according to the page
Page does not describe specific paid tiers or detailed feature limits
